title: Lace affair
html_source: The priest in Lotus Eaters is masculinity without the oomph – lace affair,[B]ald spot behind (Maud Ellmann,The Nets of Modernism: Henry James, Virginia Woolf, James Joyce, and Sigmund ,p164).
